moneyExpenses.title: Expenses
moneyExpenses.sub: Quick entry of the shop's own expenses on heads you name (office, tea, repairs …). Each one reaches the ERP with its day's summary. Salary and rent are the month's fixed costs on Costs.
moneyExpenses.notLinked: Expenses go to the ERP from the day this store switches to the new ERP contract (v6). Until then nothing can be entered here.
moneyExpenses.readOnly: You can see the expenses. Entering them needs the "Set fixed costs" permission.

entry.title: Add an expense
entry.sub: For today or a day still open in the books.
entry.head: Head
entry.where: It counts on the cost line "{line}" of that day's summary to the ERP.
entry.added: Added. It goes to the ERP with the day's summary.
entry.badAmount: Write the amount as a number above 0, for example 250.
entry.noHeads: No head yet. Add your first head under More options below.
entry.receiptHint: A photo or PDF, up to {mb} MB.

list.title: Expenses of {month}
list.sub: By head, then every entry, newest first. A wrong one is reversed, never deleted.
list.reversedNow: Reversed. The day's summary is sent again.

heads.title: More options: expense heads
heads.sub: The names you enter expenses under, each with the cost line it counts on. A head is put away, never deleted; its past expenses stay.

err.CONFLICT: This is already there (a head with this name, or the expense was reversed already).
err.RECEIPTS_OFF: Receipt photos are off. Switch them on in the setting "Receipt photo on expenses".
err.FILE_NOT_ALLOWED: Only a photo (JPG, PNG, WebP) or a PDF can be added.
